explanation: OEIS A000041 (partition numbers), Z.-W. Sun: 'Conjecture: No a(n) has the form x^m with m > 1 and x > 1.' The repository's IsPerfectPower n requires a base > 1 and an exponent > 1 (so p(0) = p(1) = 1 is correctly not a perfect power), and the statement asserts no partitionNumber k is a perfect power. Faithful.
